name: Crates of Thebes
bio: Crates of Thebes, a pupil of Diogenes the Cynic, was a Cynic philosopher of the later fourth century BC. Paton's Index of Authors includes the poet among those of Book VII. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 4th century BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the second volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book VII: 326).

poems.title: Book VII, 326
poems.author: Crates of Thebes
poems.text: I wave all I got by study and by thought and the grave things I learnt with the Muses, but all my many and rich possessions Vanity seized on.

poems.title: Book IX, 497
poems.author: Crates of Thebes
poems.text: Hunger puts an end to love, or if not hunger, time. But if neither of these put out the fire, the only cure left for you is to hang yourself.
